title: Perseverance: Castaway Chronicles
subtitle: An epic saga of survival, community building, and dinosaur defense across an uncharted primeval island
tagline: Build your colony, defend the walls, and tame the primordial wilderness.
loreSummary: After a massive ocean liner crashes on a mysterious uncharted island populated by prehistoric dinosaurs, surviving factions must build shelter, defend the settlement, and compete to become the true leaders of a new society.
keyFeatures: Chronicle campaign mode linking Episode 1 and Episode 2 with persistent outcomes
Deep dice-drafting and worker-placement Euro mechanics coupled with thematic defense
Dynamic event and incursion decks that evolve based on previous decisions
Multi-layered leadership rivalry deciding the sovereign fate of the survivor civilization

perseverance_chronicles.name: Full Chronicles Campaign (Episodes 1 & 2)
perseverance_chronicles.description: The complete interconnected campaign spanning the establishment of the camp through the frontier expansion.

perseverance_ep1.name: Episode 1: The Foothold
perseverance_ep1.description: The founding chronicle focusing on survival, initial fortifications, and repelling beach assaults.

perseverance_ep2.name: Episode 2: The Frontier
perseverance_ep2.description: The expansion chronicle focusing on dinosaur taming, specialized structures, and inland expeditions.

perseverance_extended.name: Extended Grand Chronicle
perseverance_extended.description: An exhaustive multi-generational chronicle exploring every branch of the island's evolving story.

milestones.title: The Shoreline Perimeter
milestones.description: Constructing defensive palisades and repelling the initial dinosaur incursions along the beach.

milestones.title: The First Assembly
milestones.description: Establishing civic factions and electing the inaugural council to guide colony expansion.

milestones.title: The Beast Whisperers
milestones.description: Taming native squamata beasts and venturing into uncharted primeval jungle sectors.

milestones.title: The Sovereign Citadel
milestones.description: Enduring the cataclysmic apex assault to forge an enduring, self-sustaining civilization.
